metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · The Studio
metas.description: Follows a legacy Hollywood movie studio striving to survive in a world where it is increasingly difficult for art and business to live together.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · The Residence
metas.description: Inside the White House's staff residence and the lives which workers share with the First Family.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · The Four Seasons
metas.description: Three suburban couples vacation together each season, but tensions arise when one couple splits up and the husband brings a much younger woman on subsequent trips.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Murderbot
metas.description: A security android struggles with emotions and free will while balancing dangerous missions and desire for isolation, evading detection of its self-hacking as it finds its place.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · The Ba***ds of Bollywood
metas.description: An entertaining ride through the adventures of an ambitious outsider navigating the glitzy yet tricky world of Bollywood, with self-aware humor, cameos, and larger-than-life characters for a tongue-in-cheek take on Indian cinema.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Sirens
metas.description: Devon is concerned about her sister's unhealthy relationship with her new boss.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Wonder Man
metas.description: Small-time actor Simon Williams struggles to reckon with his personal life while hiding his super-powers as he tries to land his dream role. Meanwhile, a shady government agent leverages a new friendship in order to save his own job.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Ekaki
metas.description: A group of friends plan a fun weekend getaway to the mysterious Ekaki Villa, only to find themselves caught between laughter and fear when strange haunting begin. Filled with hilarious chaos, spooky twists, and emotional moments
